title: The Irregular at Magic High School Anime Launches Production on 'Part II'
content: The official portal site for The irregular at magic high school television anime announced with a visual on Friday that production on the anime's "Part II" is launching. The announcement did not specify the release venue of Part II.

title: Baki: Strongest Proof Mobile Game's Trailer Introduces Musashi Miyamoto
content: The official YouTube channel for TMS ' anime began streaming on Wednesday a trailer for Baki : Strongest Proof , a new smartphone game for the Baki franchise , introducing Musashi Miyamoto for his launch in the game.
